_readme: INTAKE, live (Stream A, 2026-10-05): twelve spoken-style memos and the fates they must get from BOTH parsers (the Claude endpoint and the local fallback). Run: node scripts/intake-fixtures.mjs [--endpoint http://localhost:4637/api/intake] [--runs 2]. Each `expect` names the verdict words lit, the ticket kinds (order-free) and which tickets execute. ART: invented memos, no one's diary.
